_readme: HAND-WRITTEN every iteration by Claude (or the agent doing the build): what Claude is LOOKING FOR this version. Only put questions here that ONLY the user can answer (real GPU frame rate, phone feel, 'does X look right'). Then run: node tools/build-claude-check.mjs --version <Vnnn> --categories "<names>" . kinds: text | yesno | choice (needs choices) | number. device: any | desktop | phone | touch | gpu.
summary: V191: round pad buttons, vertical move + RH pitch buttons, ◬ for ConsciousHand, tool options on OmniHand/ConsciousHand pads, OmniPathNode + OmniNodeOrderPanel, floorPanelNode (Tetris pieces, picture/GIF/video faces) + FloorNodeMakerSettings grid, OmniDock_Realities, OmniState_StrictAlign (` key), wallpaper Rectangle shape, NavMap close, Perspectives entry

asks.question: Do the round option buttons around the pads read well and clear the pads?
asks.why: Judged only in software-GL screenshots; below about 842 px phone height the second-ring chips can touch.

asks.question: Is 'orbit up' (camera goes up) the direction you expect on RH ORB-U / Y?
asks.why: I assumed the camera moves up around the target.

asks.question: Is the chip + popover what you meant by bringing the OmniHand / ConsciousHand tool options out?
asks.why: Or did you want more circles directly around the pad? The phone has little room, so I used a menu.

asks.question: Does the OmniDock_Realities row look right above the Dock, with the compass at its left?
asks.why: Only seen in software-GL screenshots; the Inspector or other windows can cover it.

asks.question: On touch: tap once = tip, tap again = open panel. OK?
Does the ` key mode (StrictAlign) feel right: pick one axis, drag / nudge / type?
asks.why: Is X the right default axis? Should the terminal also keep ` when nothing is selected?

asks.question: Do the Tetris floor panels work the way you imagined, including picture / GIF / video faces?
asks.why: Real GIF and video playback was not seen on a GPU.

asks.question: Should a path node's line be a real edge so firing / sequences can follow it?
asks.why: Today it is a drawn line plus an ordered list.

asks.question: Wallpaper Rectangle: is 'square crop' the right left/right default or should it be 'mirror fill'?
asks.why: Plus is the room size right (about sphere size)?

asks.question: Keep ◉ as the eye for Perspectives (Visor and Talent use it too) or choose a unique glyph?
Is the StarLight Available / Unavailable rule right (planned items and developer tools count as Unavailable)?
asks.why: There is no role system yet, so I used: not built = Unavailable, dev tools Unavailable unless dev mode.

asks.question: Is Ctrl/Cmd+K OK for OmniStarLight?
asks.why: Browsers use it for the address bar; I block that only inside the app.

asks.question: Is the centre reticle what you imagined at 15% opacity?
asks.why: Five thin rings with ticks, arcs and cross marks, slowly turning; 'multi tech circle' was my reading.

asks.question: Is the compass panel's default spot OK (free spot, draggable)?
asks.why: It no longer sits under the logo; position is saved when you drag it.

asks.question: Is OmniNotify now where you wanted (under your profile)?
asks.why: I used the profile column's x.

asks.question: Is the landed star about the right size (about 1.3x the glyph)?

knownIssues: V191 was built as four parts merged into one; checked only in jsdom and software-GL Chromium. Nothing was judged on a real GPU, phone or touch device.
Camera ascend/descend and RH pitch were verified in jsdom only (an open Inspector covered the left pad in the Chromium run).
Real GIF and video playback on a floor panel, and real IndexedDB media save/load, were not verified.
The Realities dock row can be covered by open windows and the MiniMap corners.
Phone heights under about 842 px: second-ring pad chips can touch.
Perspectives in the toolbar is a Planned notice only; no perspectives panel exists yet.
Rectangle wallpaper 4:3 and 21:9 letterbox and ceiling/floor orientation were not screenshotted.
HelpNode (docs in scene) still not built.
V190 was built in two parts and merged (main.js merged cleanly); only software-GL Chromium and jsdom were used. Nothing was judged on a real GPU, phone or touch device.
The in-scene HelpNode is NOT built; Docs is a DOM panel only. Hook: OmniDocsPanel.openDocs.
External controls (OmniPointing) got no session clock: it has no readout area.
Floor textures are still not in export/import (floor-plane is not in KNOWN_NAMESPACES).
On a phone an open Inspector can cover the ribbon dropdown and the meter gear.
